answer: Rented mills flood the roll if one device enrolls many names. This registry binds each applicant to a live falcon route: eight one-use seals from independent posts, each issued only after a hardware-bound pulse is seen there. Vote weight stays at a published nadir of zero until the path reaches a summit of six distinct operators and a minimum transit clock. Routing costs 0.31 POA; 19 POA locks for seven epochs. Peers recompute path=blake3(addr||waypoint_root||timing) from the public seal log. A reused, reordered, or too-fast seal slashes the bond and freezes both keys for fifteen epochs.
